fields.description: Shared secret SAP sends in the X-WMSLite-Key header.
fields.label: SAP API Key

fields.description: On re-send, drop still-Pending coils absent from the new payload (Loaded coils are always protected).
fields.label: Allow Removing Pending Coils on Re-sync

fields.description: Identity = scanned QR equals the coil ID. Regex Extract = pull coil ID from capture group 1. Inventory Barcode = extract the batch code from the plant's descriptive QR (the handheld uses the same rule offline; tests/test_decode_parity.py keeps them in step).
fields.label: QR Decode Rule

fields.description: Allow loading a coil that is not on the plan (creates an Unplanned coil; supervised).
fields.label: Allow Over-scan (unplanned coils)

fields.description: By Shipment: one loading task per SAP shipment (a truck may show several). By Truck: all shipments for the same truck + delivery date are grouped into one loading task.
fields.label: Loading Task Grouping

fields.description: Only applies in By Truck mode. Whole Truck: completing finalises every shipment on the truck together (each fires its own SAP goods-issue). Per Shipment: the operator completes each shipment separately within the truck task.
fields.label: Completion Mode

fields.description: OFF (default): a fully-loaded plan waits at 'Ready to Complete' — no SAP goods-issue (PGI/GRN) and no T1 loading pushes fire until the operator presses Complete on the handheld (or a supervisor completes it from the console). ON: the plan auto-completes and pushes the moment every coil is loaded.
fields.label: Auto-complete When All Coils Loaded

fields.description: PIN a supervisor enters at the handheld to approve a short-load completion (verified online).
fields.label: Supervisor Approval PIN

fields.description: Direct pickers bin-by-bin using Bin Inventory. Off = flat coil scanning.
fields.label: Enable Bin-Directed Picking

fields.description: Identity = scanned bin QR is the bin code. Regex Extract = capture group 1 is the bin code.
fields.label: Bin QR Decode Rule
Bin QR Decode Regex (group 1 = bin code)

fields.description: Allow scanning a coil whose bin is not the one currently open.
fields.label: Allow Pick Outside Active Bin

fields.description: Mark a coil's Bin Inventory row as Picked when it is loaded.
fields.label: Mark Picked on Load

fields.description: Enable the Inventory Count task on the HHT (bin↔coil mapping capture). Requires the Inventory Recorder role.
fields.label: Enable Inventory Count

fields.description: Default QC state applied to each counted coil (per-coil override on the handheld).
fields.label: Default QC State

fields.description: Push a T1 transaction to SAP (zpwmsb) for each coil counted on the handheld, with LOCATION = the scanned bin — the same transaction the Jindal Apps Script sends. Only scans made on the handheld are pushed; rows that arrived from the SAP feed or uploads never are (RM line receipts have their own T2 switch in the RM Movement section). Uses the URL, Basic-auth user/password, SAP Username, timeout, TLS and batch size from 'SAP zpwmsb Push (outbound)' below. Scans made while this is OFF park at 'Disabled' and can be sent later with Push Now.
fields.label: Push Count Scans to SAP

fields.description: TRANSACTIONTYPE sent for count scans. SAP can assign a different code without a code change.
fields.label: Count Transaction Type

fields.description: Show the read-only Inventory card on the handheld: list coils with their bin, 20 at a time, filtered by a scanned/typed bin code or coil barcode. Every handheld role sees it.
fields.label: Enable Inventory Lookup

fields.description: Rows per page on the handheld Inventory card ('Show more' fetches the next page). Max 100.
fields.label: Inventory Page Size

fields.description: Enable the RM Movement tasks on the HHT: Gate Dispatch (scan a destination line, then coils) and Line Receipt (scan against the expected list). Requires the RM Gate Operator / RM Line Operator roles.
fields.label: Enable RM Movement

fields.description: How much recently-received history the line screen shows below the expected list, in hours.
fields.label: Received History (hours)

fields.description: Bin Code given to a brand-new coil first seen at the gate. Bin Code is mandatory, so a coil with no inventory row needs a placeholder; its scanned_at is left blank so the first real feed or count scan overrides this.
fields.label: Placeholder Bin for Unknown Coils

fields.description: Push a T2 transaction to SAP (zpwmsb) for each coil RECEIVED at a production line on the handheld, with LOCATION = the destination line — the same row shape as the loading / count T1 push. Gate dispatches are never pushed (the coil is in transit, not at a location). Uses the URL, Basic-auth user/password, SAP Username, timeout, TLS and batch size from 'SAP zpwmsb Push (outbound)' below. Receipts made while this is OFF park at 'Disabled' and can be sent later with Push Now. Undoing a receipt never tells SAP: an already-sent row keeps its status with a reconcile note.
fields.label: Push Line Receipts to SAP (T2)

fields.description: TRANSACTIONTYPE sent for line receipts. SAP can assign a different code without a code change.
fields.label: RM Receipt Transaction Type

fields.description: Comma-separated, case-insensitive. A product containing any of these words is 'Pipes' in the console's Material Type filter; any other product is 'Sheet (Coil)'; a blank product is 'Unassigned'. Site is configured in the WMSLite Site master (bin-code prefixes + SAP plant codes). Changing this re-classifies the scan ledger in the background.
fields.label: Pipe Keywords (Material Type)

fields.description: Post a goods-issue confirmation to SAP when a truck completes loading.
fields.label: Send Goods-Issue Confirmation

fields.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (client-credentials grant).
fields.label: OAuth2 Token URL

fields.description: Optional OAuth2 scope.
fields.label: OAuth2 Scope

fields.description: SAP endpoint that accepts the goods-issue confirmation (POST JSON).
fields.label: Goods-Issue URL

fields.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the SAP endpoint. Turn off only for a trusted self-signed middleware.
fields.label: Verify TLS

fields.description: Auto-send the moment a truck reaches full Completed.
fields.label: Auto-send on Full Completion

fields.description: Hold short-load (partial) confirmations until a supervisor releases them from the console.
fields.label: Hold Short-loads for Review
SAP zpwmsb Push (outbound) — shared by Loading, Inventory Count and RM Receipt

fields.description: Push a transaction to SAP (zpwmsb) for each coil loaded onto a truck. (Count scans have their own switch under Inventory Count.)
fields.label: Push Loading Transactions to SAP

fields.description: SAP zpwmsb REST endpoint (e.g. https://<your-sap-host>/sap/bc/zpwmsb/rest). Shared by the loading push and the inventory-count push, as are the credentials, SAP Username, timeout, TLS and batch size below.
fields.label: SAP Loading URL

fields.description: Value sent in the SAP USERNAME field.
fields.label: SAP Username

fields.description: Separator for LOCATION = truck_number <sep> sap_plan_id.
fields.label: Location Separator

fields.description: Refuse a scanned location that is not in the WMSLite Bin master. Stops a coil QR or a typo becoming a destination line or a count bin. Turn OFF if the master is missing a label that the floor needs today.
fields.label: Validate Scanned Locations
